# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2), as of Oct 2026

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three guides pick it as best overall ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)).
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical or shallow slats can droop. Belkin also makes a vent/dash version for awkward vents.

**Fastest charging: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool), $89.99 list**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan) and a vent clip. The Mount Guys [guide](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) uses it as their daily driver. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) lists it at $69.99 on sale.
- Full 25W only applies to the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro top out at 22W, and older models at about 15W.
- Anker doesn't support Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents. Sources disagree on the adapter: one says a 60W adapter is in the box, another says you need your own 45W+ adapter. Confirm on the listing.

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2-certified, with a fan to prevent heat throttling during navigation, and mounts on a vent or dash.
- [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) lists it at $39.99 on ESR's store, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18. They tested the code on 2026-10-22, and checkout has the final say.
- [Buy at ESR (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). It opens ESR's official US store at the same price, and Dealectric earns a commission.
- Prices vary by source: The Gadgeteer shows $18.99 to $35.99, so compare before buying. The car adapter may not be included, which could add $10 to $15.

**Other options from the guides**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, from $39.95:** [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) rates it best overall for iPhone 16/17, with a 95W adapter included.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99:** 15W with a tap-to-run Shortcuts feature, but no fan, so it may throttle on hot dashboards.
- **Budget:** LISEN 15W dash/vent mounts run about $16 to $27 in the guides' Amazon listings.

**My pick:** Belkin for simplicity, since the adapter is included. Choose Anker if you have a recent Pro iPhone and compatible vents. Choose ESR CryoBoost if you want a fan on a budget.

I couldn't open the Amazon listings, so I haven't linked them directly. Search the product names above and confirm the price and the adapter in the box before you buy.
